future_execution_pass: Path A uses only staging/temp locator and temp checkpoint inside Row27 execution folder
reload/load check records matching hash/readback for intended staged artifact

required_steps: Create execution run folder and write preflight.json with temp paths and claim locks.
Find or create only a temp/staged checkpoint artifact inside execution folder; block if no safe staged artifact path exists within 10 minutes.
Find or create only a temp locator inside execution folder; block if this touches production locator.
Run only non-mutating reload/load check against temp locator/temp checkpoint; block if only available route mutates production.
Write checkpoint-readback.json, temp-locator-readback.json, reload-result.json, rollback-proof.json, and row27-execution-report.md.
Run UI only if exact Codex host route exists before input; otherwise write UI blocker files.
Validate JSON files parse and run git diff --check -- <execution folder>.
Return PASS/NEEDS_FIX/BLOCKED with commands run, files changed, and explicit non-claims.
